description: Defines parameters, enums, structs, and classes related to PUCCH configuration in 3GPP NR (5G) specifications, including resource sets, formats, power control, and related configurations.

classes.name: pucch_common_all_formats
classes.description: Contains common parameters for a given PUCCH format, such as frequency hopping, DMRS, code rate, slots, and modulation.

classes.name: pucch_format_0_cfg
classes.description: Configuration parameters for PUCCH format 0, including initial cyclic shift.

classes.name: pucch_format_1_cfg
classes.description: Configuration parameters for PUCCH format 1, including initial cyclic shift and time domain occupancy.

classes.name: pucch_format_2_3_cfg
classes.description: Configuration for PUCCH formats 2 and 3, mainly number of PRBs.

classes.name: pucch_format_4_cfg
classes.description: Configuration for PUCCH format 4, including occupancy length and index.

classes.name: pucch_resource
classes.description: Defines a PUCCH resource with ID, starting PRB, format, and format-specific parameters.

classes.name: pucch_resource_set
classes.description: Defines a set of PUCCH resources, including resource IDs and optional max payload size.

classes.name: pucch_power_control
classes.description: Configuration for PUCCH power control, including P0 values and path-loss reference RSs.

classes.name: pucch_config
classes.description: Main configuration structure for PUCCH, including resource sets, resources, formats, power control, and scheduling requests.

methods.name: to_max_code_rate_float
methods.description: Converts max_pucch_code_rate enum to its float representation.
